svg.title: How DENT 2.0 works
svg.desc: A request goes into the /dent router, which builds a pipeline: route, plan, audit, direct, build, verify, score, improve. It draws on four pillars: knowledge, catalogues, quality and memory.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
Georgia, 'Times New Roman', Times, serif

svg.text: One command. The right pipeline. Verified.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The router reads what you want, chains the right sub-commands, and never skips verification or the score.
